Thereafter simultaneous forcing expands the exact fully observed interval by one column at each end per round, so ppt=1+q+ceil((n-L)/2); a missing rung proves no earlier completion. Counting 2n,2n,2n,n,2n,2n eligible pairs establishes the parity-split polynomial. The prerequisite iff eligibility is Girish–Somasundaram 2024 Lemma 2, inspected in full context. The delivered verifier independently enumerates every unordered pair for n=7..50, confirms 13,794 successful pairs, 264 base cases and all required time bins. This is an all-n proof and finite corroboration, not a claim of infinite machine checking.

value.rationale: This is a complete all-order time-graded classification of minimum sensor placements for a standard cubic network family, with a nontrivial parity change in fast-placement proportion from 3/11 to 9/11. Power propagation latency is a natural optimization criterion beyond minimum sensor number; the exact time bins and frequencies support latency-aware minimum-cost placement. The novelty is not an ungraded 11n count or a known pair criterion, and all intervals n>=7 are proved without a finite-only extrapolation.
